column3: “Gifts” specifies the spiritual things; prophesying becomes the gift of prophecy.
Speaking is recast as bringing revelation, knowledge, prophecy, or teaching.
“Tune” supplies an object for what is played.
“Assuredly” replaces the qualification; the sounds are languages and lack of voice becomes lack of meaning.
“Meaning of someone’s language” explains the power of the voice.
“Spiritual gifts” explains spirits; gifts that build up specify the object of excelling.
The person occupying the place is simply described as uninstructed.
“Shall we say” supplies a speech verb; “the church” supplies the object of edification.
“What is said” supplies the object of discerning.
